To determine whether each stationary point is a maximum, minimum, or neither, find the second derivative, f''(x), and evaluate it at each stationary point. If f''(x) is positive, the point is a local minimum. If f''(x) is negative, the point is a local maximum. If f''(x) is zero, the test is inconclusive.
